description: Full structural/evolutionary test of TIN-44 Tim44 features: domain identity, CTD superposition on 2CW9/2FXT, lipid cavity residue conservation, pLDDT, presequence amphipathicity
code:
# ============================================================================
# TIN-44 (C. elegans, O02161) vs Tim44 (yeast Q01852 / human O43615)
# Self-contained: sequences -> alignment -> residue mapping -> structure
# superposition -> cavity mapping -> pLDDT -> presequence amphipathicity
# ============================================================================
import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd, json
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

H={"User-Agent":"Mozilla/5.0 (X11; Linux x86_64)"}
def fetch(u):
    r=requests.get(u,headers=H,timeout=120); r.raise_for_status(); return r.text

accs={"WORM":"O02161","YEAST":"Q01852","HUMAN":"O43615"}
seqs={k:"".join(fetch(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{v}.fasta").strip().split("\n")[1:]) for k,v in accs.items()}
print({k:len(v) for k,v in seqs.items()})

# ---------------- BLOSUM62 + affine NW ----------------
B62_txt="""   A  R  N  D  C  Q  E  G  H  I  L  K  M  F  P  S  T  W  Y  V
A  4 -1 -2 -2  0 -1 -1  0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1  1  0 -3 -2  0
R -1  5  0 -2 -3  1  0 -2  0 -3 -2  2 -1 -3 -2 -1 -1 -3 -2 -3
N -2  0  6  1 -3  0  0  0  1 -3 -3  0 -2 -3 -2  1  0 -4 -2 -3
D -2 -2  1  6 -3  0  2 -1 -1 -3 -4 -1 -3 -3 -1  0 -1 -4 -3 -3
C  0 -3 -3 -3  9 -3 -4 -3 -3 -1 -1 -3 -1 -2 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1
Q -1  1  0  0 -3  5  2 -2  0 -3 -2  1  0 -3 -1  0 -1 -2 -1 -2
E -1  0  0  2 -4  2  5 -2  0 -3 -3  1 -2 -3 -1  0 -1 -3 -2 -2
G  0 -2  0 -1 -3 -2 -2  6 -2 -4 -4 -2 -3 -3 -2  0 -2 -2 -3 -3
H -2  0  1 -1 -3  0  0 -2  8 -3 -3 -1 -2 -1 -2 -1 -2 -2  2 -3
I -1 -3 -3 -3 -1 -3 -3 -4 -3  4  2 -3  1  0 -3 -2 -1 -3 -1  3
L -1 -2 -3 -4 -1 -2 -3 -4 -3  2  4 -2  2  0 -3 -2 -1 -2 -1  1
K -1  2  0 -1 -3  1  1 -2 -1 -3 -2  5 -1 -3 -1  0 -1 -3 -2 -2
M -1 -1 -2 -3 -1  0 -2 -3 -2  1  2 -1  5  0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1  1
F -2 -3 -3 -3 -2 -3 -3 -3 -1  0  0 -3  0  6 -4 -2 -2  1  3 -1
P -1 -2 -2 -1 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 -1 -2 -4  7 -1 -1 -4 -3 -2
S  1 -1  1  0 -1  0  0  0 -1 -2 -2  0 -1 -2 -1  4  1 -3 -2 -2
T  0 -1  0 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1  1  5 -2 -2  0
W -3 -3 -4 -4 -2 -2 -3 -2 -2 -3 -2 -3 -1  1 -4 -3 -2 11  2 -3
Y -2 -2 -2 -3 -2 -1 -2 -3  2 -1 -1 -2 -1  3 -3 -2 -2  2  7 -1
V  0 -3 -3 -3 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3  3  1 -2  1 -1 -2 -2  0 -3 -1  4"""
rows=B62_txt.strip().split("\n"); aa=rows[0].split(); B62={}
for line in rows[1:]:
    p=line.split()
    for j,x in enumerate(p[1:]): B62[(p[0],aa[j])]=int(x)
def sc(a,b): return B62.get((a,b),-4)

def nw(s1,s2,go=-11,ge=-1):
    n,m=len(s1),len(s2); NEG=-1e9
    M=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG);Ix=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG);Iy=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG)
    pM=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8);pX=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8);pY=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8)
    M[0,0]=0
    for i in range(1,n+1): Ix[i,0]=go+ge*(i-1); pX[i,0]=1
    for j in range(1,m+1): Iy[0,j]=go+ge*(j-1); pY[0,j]=2
    S=np.array([[sc(a,b) for b in s2] for a in s1],float)
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        for j in range(1,m+1):
            c=(M[i-1,j-1],Ix[i-1,j-1],Iy[i-1,j-1]);k=int(np.argmax(c));M[i,j]=c[k]+S[i-1,j-1];pM[i,j]=k
            c=(M[i-1,j]+go,Ix[i-1,j]+ge,Iy[i-1,j]+go);k=int(np.argmax(c));Ix[i,j]=c[k];pX[i,j]=k
            c=(M[i,j-1]+go,Ix[i,j-1]+go,Iy[i,j-1]+ge);k=int(np.argmax(c));Iy[i,j]=c[k];pY[i,j]=k
    i,j=n,m; st=int(np.argmax((M[n,m],Ix[n,m],Iy[n,m]))); A=[];Bb=[]
    while i>0 or j>0:
        if st==0: A.append(s1[i-1]);Bb.append(s2[j-1]);ns=pM[i,j];i-=1;j-=1;st=ns
        elif st==1: A.append(s1[i-1]);Bb.append('-');ns=pX[i,j];i-=1;st=ns
        else: A.append('-');Bb.append(s2[j-1]);ns=pY[i,j];j-=1;st=ns
        if i==0 and j>0 and st!=2: st=2
        if j==0 and i>0 and st!=1: st=1
    return "".join(reversed(A)),"".join(reversed(Bb))

def mapping(ref,qry):
    A,Bb=nw(ref,qry); i=j=0; mp={}
    for x,y in zip(A,Bb):
        if x!='-': i+=1
        if y!='-': j+=1
        if x!='-': mp[i]=(j if y!='-' else None, x, y)
    return mp,A,Bb

mp_h,Ah,Bh = mapping(seqs["HUMAN"], seqs["WORM"])
mp_y,Ay,By = mapping(seqs["YEAST"], seqs["WORM"])

def pct(mp, lo, hi):
    sel=[(r,v) for r,v in mp.items() if lo<=r<=hi]
    al=[v for r,v in sel if v[0] is not None]
    ident=sum(1 for v in al if v[1]==v[2]); sim=sum(1 for v in al if sc(v[1],v[2])>0)
    return len(al), 100*ident/len(al), 100*sim/len(al)

print("\n=== Domain-resolved identity to TIN-44 (reference numbering) ===")
tab=[]
for name,mp,bnd in [("human TIMM44",mp_h,(265,266,452)),("yeast Tim44",mp_y,(233,234,431))]:
    nN,iN,sN = pct(mp,1,bnd[0]); nC,iC,sC = pct(mp,bnd[1],bnd[2]); nA,iA,sA = pct(mp,1,bnd[2])
    tab.append([name,"full",nA,round(iA,1),round(sA,1)])
    tab.append([name,f"N-term 1-{bnd[0]}",nN,round(iN,1),round(sN,1)])
    tab.append([name,f"C-term {bnd[1]}-{bnd[2]}",nC,round(iC,1),round(sC,1)])
dom=pd.DataFrame(tab,columns=["reference","region","aligned_res","%identity_to_TIN44","%similarity_to_TIN44"])
print(dom.to_string(index=False))

# ---------------- structures ----------------
AA3={'ALA':'A','ARG':'R','ASN':'N','ASP':'D','CYS':'C','GLN':'Q','GLU':'E','GLY':'G','HIS':'H','ILE':'I',
     'LEU':'L','LYS':'K','MET':'M','PHE':'F','PRO':'P','SER':'S','THR':'T','TRP':'W','TYR':'Y','VAL':'V','MSE':'M'}
def parse(txt, chain='A'):
    prot=[]; het=[]
    for l in txt.split("\n"):
        if l[:6].strip() in ('ATOM','HETATM'):
            if l[21]!=chain and l[:6].strip()=='ATOM': continue
            if l[16] not in (' ','A'): continue
            resn=l[17:20].strip()
            try: d=dict(name=l[12:16].strip(),resn=resn,resi=int(l[22:26]),
                        xyz=np.array([float(l[30:38]),float(l[38:46]),float(l[46:54])]),
                        b=float(l[60:66]) if l[60:66].strip() else np.nan, ch=l[21])
            except ValueError: continue
            if resn in AA3: prot.append(d)
            elif l.startswith('HETATM'): het.append(d)
    return prot,het

worm_prot,_ = parse(fetch("https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/files/AF-O02161-F1-model_v6.pdb"))
h_prot,h_het = parse(fetch("https://files.rcsb.org/download/2CW9.pdb"))
y_prot,y_het = parse(fetch("https://files.rcsb.org/download/2FXT.pdb"))
h_prot=[a for a in h_prot if a['ch']=='A']; h_het=[a for a in h_het if a['ch']=='A']
y_prot=[a for a in y_prot if a['ch']=='A']
CA=lambda P:{a['resi']:a['xyz'] for a in P if a['name']=='CA'}
ca_w,ca_h,ca_y = CA(worm_prot),CA(h_prot),CA(y_prot)
plddt={a['resi']:a['b'] for a in worm_prot if a['name']=='CA'}
print("\nresolved CA: worm AF",len(ca_w),"2CW9",len(ca_h),"2FXT",len(ca_y))

def kabsch(P,Q):
    pm,qm=P.mean(0),Q.mean(0); Pc,Qc=P-pm,Q-qm
    V,S,Wt=np.linalg.svd(Pc.T@Qc); d=np.sign(np.linalg.det(V@Wt)); R=V@np.diag([1,1,d])@Wt
    return R,pm,qm,float(np.sqrt((((Pc@R)-Qc)**2).sum(1).mean()))

print("\n=== Alignment-guided Calpha superposition of the AlphaFold TIN-44 CTD ===")
supers={}
for tag,mp,cref in [("human 2CW9",mp_h,ca_h),("yeast 2FXT",mp_y,ca_y)]:
    pairs=[(r,v[0]) for r,v in mp.items() if v[0] is not None and r in cref and v[0] in ca_w]
    P=np.array([cref[r] for r,_ in pairs]); Q=np.array([ca_w[q] for _,q in pairs])
    R,pm,qm,rms=kabsch(P,Q)
    d=np.sqrt((((P-pm)@R)-(Q-qm))**2).sum(1)**0.5
    d=np.sqrt(((((P-pm)@R)-(Q-qm))**2).sum(1))
    keep=d<4.0
    R2,pm2,qm2,rms2=kabsch(P[keep],Q[keep])
    ident=sum(1 for r,q in pairs if mp[r][1]==mp[r][2])
    print(f"{tag}: n={len(pairs)} pairs | all-pair RMSD {rms:.2f} A | core n={keep.sum()} ({100*keep.mean():.0f}%) RMSD {rms2:.2f} A | identity {ident}/{len(pairs)} = {100*ident/len(pairs):.1f}%")
    supers[tag]=dict(pairs=pairs,R=R2,pm=pm2,qm=qm2,rms=rms,rms_core=rms2,d=d,keep=keep)

# ---------------- cavity: 1PE (pentaethylene glycol) contacts in 2CW9 ----------------
lig=[a for a in h_het if a['resn']=='1PE']
print(f"\n=== 2CW9 lipid-mimetic (1PE) binding sites: {len(lig)} ligand atoms in {len(set(a['resi'] for a in lig))} molecules ===")
pxyz=np.array([a['xyz'] for a in h_prot]); pmeta=[(a['resi'],a['resn']) for a in h_prot]
contact={}
for a in lig:
    dd=np.linalg.norm(pxyz-a['xyz'],axis=1)
    for i in np.where(dd<4.5)[0]:
        ri,rn=pmeta[i]
        c=contact.setdefault(ri,[rn,a['resi'],99.]); c[2]=min(c[2],float(dd[i])); c[1]=a['resi']
rows=[]
for ri in sorted(contact):
    rn,ligid,dmin=contact[ri]; v=mp_h.get(ri)
    worm=f"{v[2]}{v[0]}" if v and v[0] else "gap"
    cons = "identical" if (v and v[0] and v[1]==v[2]) else ("similar" if (v and v[0] and sc(v[1],v[2])>0) else "different")
    rows.append([f"{AA3[rn]}{ri}", f"1PE_{ligid}", round(dmin,2), worm, cons])
cav=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=["human_residue","ligand","min_dist_A","TIN44_equivalent","conservation"])
print(cav.to_string(index=False))
n=len(cav); ni=(cav.conservation=="identical").sum(); ns=(cav.conservation=="similar").sum()
print(f"\ncavity/lipid-contact residues n={n}: identical {ni} ({100*ni/n:.0f}%), similar {ns}, different {n-ni-ns}")

# ---------------- pLDDT by region ----------------
regs={"1-40 (presequence)":(1,40),"41-110 (NTD helix-1)":(41,110),"111-200 (NTD coiled coil)":(111,200),
      "201-240 (linker)":(201,240),"241-425 (CTD, 2CW9-equivalent)":(241,425)}
print("\n=== TIN-44 AlphaFold pLDDT by region ===")
pl=[]
for k,(lo,hi) in regs.items():
    v=[plddt[r] for r in range(lo,hi+1) if r in plddt]
    pl.append([k,len(v),round(float(np.mean(v)),1),round(float(np.median(v)),1)])
    print(f"  {k}: n={len(v)} mean pLDDT={np.mean(v):.1f} median={np.median(v):.1f}")
pldf=pd.DataFrame(pl,columns=["region","n","mean_pLDDT","median_pLDDT"])

# ---------------- N-terminal presequence amphipathicity ----------------
KD={'A':1.8,'R':-4.5,'N':-3.5,'D':-3.5,'C':2.5,'Q':-3.5,'E':-3.5,'G':-0.4,'H':-3.2,'I':4.5,'L':3.8,
    'K':-3.9,'M':1.9,'F':2.8,'P':-1.6,'S':-0.8,'T':-0.7,'W':-0.9,'Y':-1.3,'V':4.2}
EI={'A':0.62,'R':-2.53,'N':-0.78,'D':-0.90,'C':0.29,'Q':-0.85,'E':-0.74,'G':0.48,'H':-0.40,'I':1.38,
    'L':1.06,'K':-1.50,'M':0.64,'F':1.19,'P':0.12,'S':-0.18,'T':-0.05,'W':0.81,'Y':0.26,'V':1.08}
def muH(s,scale=EI,delta=100.0):
    ang=np.deg2rad(delta*np.arange(len(s)))
    h=np.array([scale.get(c,0) for c in s])
    return float(np.hypot((h*np.cos(ang)).sum(),(h*np.sin(ang)).sum())/len(s))
def netcharge(s): return sum(1 for c in s if c in 'KR') - sum(1 for c in s if c in 'DE')
print("\n=== N-terminal 1-35 presequence-like properties ===")
pre=[]
for k in ["WORM","YEAST","HUMAN"]:
    s=seqs[k][:35]
    pre.append([k,s,netcharge(s),s.count('D')+s.count('E'),round(muH(s),3),round(float(np.mean([KD[c] for c in s])),2)])
    print(f"  {k}: {s}  net_charge=+{netcharge(s)} acidic={s.count('D')+s.count('E')} muH(100deg,Eisenberg)={muH(s):.3f}")
# negative control: C-terminal 35 residues of the same proteins (not targeting signals)
for k in ["WORM","YEAST","HUMAN"]:
    s=seqs[k][-35:]
    print(f"  CONTROL {k} C-term35: net_charge={netcharge(s)} muH={muH(s):.3f}")
predf=pd.DataFrame(pre,columns=["protein","Nterm35","net_charge","n_acidic","hydrophobic_moment","mean_KD"])

# ---------------- figure ----------------
fig,axes=plt.subplots(2,2,figsize=(14,9))
ax=axes[0,0]
x=sorted(plddt); y=[plddt[r] for r in x]
ax.plot(x,y,lw=1,color='#2b6cb0'); ax.axhline(70,ls='--',c='grey',lw=1)
for lo,hi,lab,col in [(1,40,'presequence','#f6ad55'),(41,240,'N-terminal domain','#9ae6b4'),(241,425,'C-terminal (Tim44) domain','#90cdf4')]:
    ax.axvspan(lo,hi,alpha=.25,color=col); ax.text((lo+hi)/2,101,lab,ha='center',fontsize=8)
ax.set_xlabel('TIN-44 residue'); ax.set_ylabel('pLDDT'); ax.set_ylim(0,108)
ax.set_title('AlphaFold confidence, TIN-44 (O02161)')

ax=axes[0,1]
sup=supers["human 2CW9"]; dd=sup['d']; rr=[p[1] for p in sup['pairs']]
ax.scatter(rr,dd,s=10,c=['#2f855a' if k else '#c53030' for k in sup['keep']])
ax.axhline(4,ls='--',c='grey',lw=1)
ax.set_xlabel('TIN-44 residue'); ax.set_ylabel('Calpha deviation vs 2CW9 (A)')
ax.set_title(f"TIN-44 CTD on human TIMM44 CTD (2CW9)\ncore RMSD {sup['rms_core']:.2f} A over {sup['keep'].sum()} Calpha")

ax=axes[1,0]
cc=cav.conservation.value_counts().reindex(['identical','similar','different']).fillna(0)
ax.bar(cc.index,cc.values,color=['#2f855a','#dd6b20','#c53030'])
for i,v in enumerate(cc.values): ax.text(i,v+0.2,int(v),ha='center')
ax.set_ylabel('residues'); ax.set_title('Conservation in TIN-44 of the 2CW9\nlipid-mimetic (pentaethylene glycol) contact residues')

ax=axes[1,1]
d2=dom[dom.region!='full']
labs=[f"{r.reference}\n{r.region.split()[0]}" for r in d2.itertuples()]
ax.bar(range(len(d2)),d2['%identity_to_TIN44'],color=['#4299e1','#2b6cb0','#f6ad55','#dd6b20'])
ax.set_xticks(range(len(d2))); ax.set_xticklabels(labs,fontsize=8)
ax.set_ylabel('% identity to TIN-44'); ax.set_title('Domain-resolved identity to TIN-44')
for i,v in enumerate(d2['%identity_to_TIN44']): ax.text(i,v+0.5,f"{v:.0f}%",ha='center',fontsize=8)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()

print("\nDONE")
